images.title: Nine odd steps down from 81
images.purpose: Shows 81 reduced to 0 by subtracting 1, 3, 5, up to 17, in exactly 9 steps, so √81 = 9.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One descending staircase line on a plain vertical scale, centred, with labels only at its start and end.
images.exact_structure: A staircase drawn as a thick teal (#0072B2) line going from left to right and downwards, starting at height 81 and ending at height 0, with exactly 9 downward steps of equal width. The heights after each step are 80, 77, 72, 65, 56, 45, 32, 17 and 0 (not written), so the drops grow: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17. The starting height is labelled 81 and the floor is labelled 0. The first drop is tagged − 1 and the last drop is tagged − 17, both in amber (#E69F00). A dark brace along the top spans all 9 steps and is tagged 9 steps. To the right of the staircase: √81 = 9 in reddish purple (#CC79A7). Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: The number of odd numbers subtracted to reach 0 is the square root.
